units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 李渾，字季初，趙郡栢人人也。
units.en: Li Hun, styled Jichu, was a man of Bairen in Zhao commandery.
units.literal: Li Hun, styled Jichu, was a man of Bairen in Zhao commandery.

units.zh: 曾祖靈，魏鉅鹿公。
units.en: His great-grandfather Ling was duke of Julu under Wei.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Ling was Duke of Julu under Wei.

units.zh: 父遵，魏冀州征東府司馬，京兆王愉冀州起逆，遇害。
units.en: His father Zun was staff officer of the eastern campaigning headquarters in Jizhou under Wei; when Prince Jingzhao Yu rose in revolt in Jizhou, he met disaster and was killed.
units.literal: His father Zun was staff officer of the Eastern Campaigning Headquarters in Jizhou under Wei; when Prince Jingzhao Yu rose in revolt in Jizhou, he met disaster and was killed.

units.zh: 渾以父死王事，除給事中。
units.en: Because his father died in the prince's service, Hun was appointed attendant within the yellow gates.
units.literal: Because his father died in the prince's service, Hun was appointed attendant within the yellow gates.

units.zh: 時四方多難，乃謝病，求為青州征東府司馬。
units.en: When troubles multiplied on all sides, he resigned on grounds of illness and sought appointment as staff officer of the eastern campaigning headquarters in Qingzhou.
units.literal: When troubles multiplied on all sides, he resigned on grounds of illness and sought appointment as staff officer of the Eastern Campaigning Headquarters in Qingzhou.

units.zh: 與河間邢卲、北海王昕俱奉老母、攜妻子同赴青、齊。
units.en: Together with Xing Shao of Hejian and Wang Xin of Beihai, they all supported their aged mothers and took wives and children on the same journey to Qing and Qi.
units.literal: Together with Xing Shao of Hejian and Wang Xin of Beihai, they each supported their aged mothers and took wives and children on the same journey to Qing and Qi.

units.zh: 未幾而尒朱榮入洛，衣冠殲盡。
units.en: Before long Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang and the gentry were wiped out.
units.literal: Before long Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang and the gentry were wiped out.

units.zh: 論者以為知機。
units.en: Commentators held that he had read the times aright.
units.literal: Those who commented considered that he had shown foresight.

units.zh: 永安初，除散騎常侍。
units.en: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed attendant cavalier in regular attendance.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed attendant cavalier in regular attendance.

units.zh: 普泰中，崔社客反於海岱，攻圍青州。
units.en: In the Putai era, Cui Sheke rebelled in Hai and Dai and besieged Qingzhou.
units.literal: In the Putai era, Cui Sheke rebelled in Hai and Dai and besieged Qingzhou.

units.zh: 詔渾為征東將軍、都官尚書，行臺赴援。
units.en: An edict appointed Hun general of the eastern campaign and director of the ministry of justice, with mobile headquarters to go to the rescue.
units.literal: An edict appointed Hun general of the eastern campaign and director of the ministry of justice, with mobile headquarters to go to the rescue.

units.zh: 而社客宿將多謀，諸城各自保，固壁清野。
units.en: Sheke had many veteran officers full of schemes; each city held its own ground, securing the walls and clearing the countryside.
units.literal: Sheke had many veteran officers who were schemers; each city kept its own defenses, securing the walls and clearing the countryside.

units.zh: 時議有異同。
units.en: Opinion at the time was divided.
units.literal: Opinion at the time was divided.

units.zh: 渾曰：「社客賊之根本，圍城復逾晦朔。
units.en: Hun said, "Sheke is the root of the rebels; the siege has already passed a full month.
units.literal: Hun said: "Sheke is the root of the bandits; the siege has already passed a new and full moon.

units.zh: 烏合之眾，易可崩離。
units.en: A mob gathered in a day can easily be broken apart.
units.literal: A mob gathered in a day can easily be broken apart.

units.zh: 若簡練驍勇，銜枚夜襲，徑趣營下，出其不意，咄嗟之間，便可擒殄。
units.en: If we pick crack troops, gag them for a night assault, strike straight for the camp, and take them unawares, in a trice we can capture and destroy them.
units.literal: If we pick crack troops, gag them for a night assault, strike straight for the camp, and take them unawares, in a trice we can capture and destroy them.

units.zh: 如社客就擒，則諸郡可傳檄而定。
units.en: Once Sheke is taken, the commanderies can be settled by proclamation alone.
units.literal: Once Sheke is taken, the commanderies can be settled by proclamation alone.

units.zh: 何意冒熱攻城，疲損軍士。」
units.en: Why insist on storming the city in the heat and wearing down the troops?"
units.literal: Why insist on storming the city in the heat and wearing down the troops?"

units.zh: 諸將遲疑，渾乃決行。
units.en: The generals hesitated; Hun decided to proceed anyway.
units.literal: The generals hesitated; Hun decided to proceed anyway.

units.zh: 未明，達城下，賊徒驚散，生擒社客，斬首送洛。
units.en: Before dawn they reached below the walls; the rebel host scattered in alarm; Sheke was captured alive and his head was sent to Luoyang.
units.literal: Before dawn they reached below the walls; the rebel host scattered in alarm; Sheke was captured alive; his head was sent to Luoyang.

units.zh: 海隅清定。
units.en: The coastal regions were pacified.
units.literal: The coastal regions were pacified.

units.zh: 後除光祿大夫，兼常侍，聘使至梁。
units.en: Later he was appointed grand master for illuminating government and concurrent regular attendant, and sent as envoy to Liang.
units.literal: Later he was appointed grand master for illuminating government and concurrent regular attendant, envoy to Liang.

units.zh: 梁武謂之曰：「伯陽之後，久而彌盛，趙李人物，今實居多。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Liang said to him, "Descendants of Boyang — the longer the line runs, the more it flourishes; men of the Zhao Li clan are truly numerous today.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang said to him: "Descendants of Boyang — the longer, the more they flourish; men of the Zhao Li clan are truly numerous today.

units.zh: 常侍曾經將領，今復充使，文武不墜，良屬斯人。」
units.en: You once served as a commander; now again you fill an envoy's post — civil and military alike unbroken. How fitting in such a man."
units.literal: The attendant once served as a commander; now again you fill an envoy's post — civil and military alike unbroken: how fitting in such a man."

units.zh: 使還，為東郡太守，以贓徵還。
units.en: On his return he became administrator of Dong commandery; he was recalled on charges of corruption.
units.literal: On return he became administrator of Dong commandery; he was recalled on charges of corruption.

units.zh: 世宗使武士提以入，渾抗言曰：「將軍今日猶自禮賢耶？」
units.en: Gao Cheng had warriors seize and bring him in; Hun spoke up boldly, "Does the general still treat the worthy with courtesy today?"
units.literal: Gao Cheng had warriors seize and bring him in; Hun spoke up boldly: "Does the general still treat the worthy with courtesy today?"

units.zh: 世宗笑而捨之。
units.en: Gao Cheng laughed and let him go.
units.literal: Gao Cheng laughed and let him go.

units.zh: 天保初，除太子少保。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent.

units.zh: 時邢卲為少師，楊愔為少傅，論者為榮。
units.en: At the time Xing Shao was junior preceptor and Yang Yin junior tutor; commentators took it as an honor.
units.literal: At the time Xing Shao was junior preceptor and Yang Yin junior tutor; commentators took it as an honor.

units.zh: 以參禪代儀註，賜爵涇陽縣男。
units.en: Because he took part in the rites and regulations of the dynastic transition, he was granted the title baron of Jingyang county.
units.literal: Because he took part in the rites and regulations of the dynastic transition, he was granted the title Baron of Jingyang county.

units.zh: 刪定《麟趾格》。
units.en: He helped revise the Linzhi Code.
units.literal: He helped revise the Linzhi Code.

units.zh: 尋除海州刺史。
units.en: Soon he was appointed governor of Haizhou.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed governor of Haizhou.

units.zh: 土人反，共攻州城。
units.en: The local people rebelled and together attacked the prefectural city.
units.literal: The local people rebelled and together attacked the prefectural city.

units.zh: 城中多石，無井，常食海水。
units.en: The city had much stone and no wells; they regularly drank seawater.
units.literal: The city had much stone and no wells; they regularly drank seawater.

units.zh: 賊絕其路。
units.en: The rebels cut off their routes.
units.literal: The rebels cut off their routes.

units.zh: 城內先有一池，時旱久涸，一朝天雨，泉流湧溢。
units.en: Within the city there was already a pool; after long drought it had dried up, but one morning heaven sent rain and springs gushed forth in flood.
units.literal: Within the city there was already a pool; after long drought it had dried up, but one morning heaven sent rain and springs gushed forth in flood.

units.zh: 賊以為神，應時駭散。
units.en: The rebels took it for a miracle and scattered in alarm at once.
units.literal: The rebels took it for a miracle and scattered in alarm at once.

units.zh: 渾督勵將士，捕斬渠帥。
units.en: Hun urged on his officers and soldiers and captured and beheaded the ringleaders.
units.literal: Hun urged on his officers and soldiers and captured and beheaded the ringleaders.

units.zh: 渾妾郭氏在州干政納貨，坐免官。
units.en: Hun's concubine Lady Guo meddled in government at the prefecture and took bribes; on that charge he was dismissed from office.
units.literal: Hun's concubine Lady Guo meddled in government at the prefecture and took bribes; on that charge he was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 卒。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 子湛，字處元。
units.en: His son Zhan, styled Chuyuan.
units.literal: His son Zhan, styled Chuyuan.

units.zh: 涉獵文史，有家風。
units.en: He ranged widely in letters and histories and had the family's manner.
units.literal: He ranged widely in letters and histories and had the family's manner.

units.zh: 為太子舍人，兼常侍，聘陳使副。
units.en: He served as attendant to the heir apparent, concurrent regular attendant, and deputy envoy on a mission to Chen.
units.literal: He served as attendant to the heir apparent, concurrent regular attendant, and deputy envoy on a mission to Chen.

units.zh: 襲爵涇陽縣男。
units.en: He inherited the title baron of Jingyang county.
units.literal: He inherited the title Baron of Jingyang county.

units.zh: 渾與弟繪、緯俱為聘梁使主，湛又為使副，是以趙郡人士，目為四使之門。
units.en: Hun and his brothers Hui and Wei had all been chief envoys on missions to Liang; Zhan again served as deputy envoy — hence men of Zhao commandery called them the Gate of Four Envoys.
units.literal: Hun and his brothers Hui and Wei had all been chief envoys on missions to Liang; Zhan again served as deputy envoy — hence men of Zhao commandery called them the Gate of Four Envoys.

units.zh: 繪，字敬文。
units.en: Hui, styled Jingwen.
units.literal: Hui, styled Jingwen.

units.zh: 年六歲，便自願入學，家人偶以年俗忌，約而弗許。
units.en: At age six he himself wished to enter school; his family, by chance observing a taboo of the year, restrained him and would not allow it.
units.literal: At age six he himself wished to enter school; his family, by chance observing a taboo of the year, restrained him and would not allow it.

units.zh: 伺其伯姊筆牘之間，而輒竊用，未幾遂通《急就章》。
units.en: He watched his elder cousin sister between brush and inkstone and would steal use of them; before long he had mastered the Jijiuzhang.
units.literal: He watched his elder cousin sister between brush and inkstone and would steal use of them; before long he had mastered the Jijiuzhang.

units.zh: 內外異之，以為非常兒也。
units.en: Inside and outside the family marveled at him, considering him no ordinary child.
units.literal: Inside and outside the family marveled at him, considering him no ordinary child.

units.zh: 及長，儀貌端偉，神情朗儁。
units.en: When grown, his bearing was dignified and imposing, his spirit bright and outstanding.
units.literal: When grown, his bearing was dignified and imposing, his spirit bright and outstanding.

units.zh: 河間邢晏，卽繪舅也，與繪清言，歎其高遠。
units.en: Xing Yan of Hejian — Hui's maternal uncle — conversed in pure talk with Hui and admired his loftiness.
units.literal: Xing Yan of Hejian — Hui's maternal uncle — conversed in pure talk with Hui and admired his loftiness.

units.zh: 每稱曰：「若披雲霧，如對珠玉，宅相之寄，良在此甥。」
units.en: He often praised him, "As if parting the clouds and mist, as if facing pearls and jade — the hopes of the clan seat rest on this nephew."
units.literal: He often praised him: "As if parting the clouds and mist, as if facing pearls and jade — the hopes of the clan seat rest on this nephew."

units.zh: 齊王蕭寶夤引為主簿記室，專管表檄，待以賓友之禮。
units.en: Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin brought him in as chief clerk and recorder, put him in charge of memorials and proclamations, and treated him with the courtesy due a guest and friend.
units.literal: Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin brought him in as chief clerk and recorder, put him in charge of memorials and proclamations, and treated him with the courtesy due a guest and friend.

units.zh: 司徒高邕辟為從事中郎，徵至洛。
units.en: Grand Secretary Gao Yong summoned him as attendant gentleman; he was called to Luoyang.
units.literal: Grand Secretary Gao Yong summoned him as attendant gentleman; he was called to Luoyang.

units.zh: 時勑侍中西河王、秘書監常景選儒學十人緝撰五禮，繪與太原王乂同掌軍禮。
units.en: At the time an edict had the attendant-in-ordinary Prince of Xihe and Secretary Director Chang Jing select ten Confucian scholars to compile the Five Rites; Hui and Wang Yi of Taiyuan together took charge of military rites.
units.literal: At the time an edict had the attendant-in-ordinary Prince Xihe of the Western River, Secretary Director Chang Jing, and ten Confucian scholars compile the Five Rites; Hui and Wang Yi of Taiyuan together took charge of military rites.

units.zh: 魏靜帝於顯陽殿講《孝經》、《禮記》，繪與從弟騫、裴伯茂、魏收、盧元明等俱為錄議。
units.en: Emperor Jing of Wei lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Record of Rites at the Xianyang Hall; Hui and his cousin Qian, Pei Bomo, Wei Shou, Lu Yuanming, and others were all recorders and discussants.
units.literal: Emperor Jing of Wei lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Record of Rites at the Xianyang Hall; Hui and his cousin Qian, Pei Bomo, Wei Shou, Lu Yuanming, and others were all recorders and discussants.

units.zh: 素長筆札，尤能傳受，緝綴詞議，簡舉可觀。
units.en: He had long excelled at letters; he was especially able to transmit and receive; in compiling and stitching together discussions, his selections were worth viewing.
units.literal: He had long excelled at letters; he was especially able to transmit and receive; in compiling and stitching together discussions, his selections were worth viewing.

units.zh: 天平初，世宗用為丞相司馬。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianping, Gao Cheng employed him as staff officer to the chancellor.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, Gao Cheng employed him as staff officer to the chancellor.

units.zh: 每罷朝，文武總集，對揚王庭，常令繪先發言端，為群僚之首。
units.en: Whenever court adjourned, civil and military officials would all assemble and debate before the royal court; he was regularly made to open the discussion, first among the officials.
units.literal: Whenever court adjourned, civil and military officials would all assemble and debate before the royal court; he was regularly made to open the discussion, first among the officials.

units.zh: 音辭辯正，風儀都雅，聽者悚然。
units.en: His words were clear and correct, his bearing altogether elegant; listeners were awed.
units.literal: His words were clear and correct, his bearing altogether elegant; listeners were awed.

units.zh: 武定初，兼常侍，為聘梁使主。
units.en: At the beginning of Wuding he was concurrent regular attendant and chief envoy on a mission to Liang.
units.literal: At the beginning of Wuding he was concurrent regular attendant and chief envoy on a mission to Liang.

units.zh: 梁武帝問繪：「高相今在何處？」
units.en: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Hui, "Where is Chancellor Gao now?"
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Hui: "Where is Chancellor Gao now?"

units.zh: 繪曰：「今在晉陽，肅遏邊寇。」
units.en: Hui said, "He is now at Jinyang, sternly repelling border raiders."
units.literal: Hui said: "He is now at Jinyang, sternly repelling border raiders."

units.zh: 梁武曰：「黑獺若為形容？
units.en: Emperor Wu said, "What is Black Badger's appearance like?
units.literal: Emperor Wu said: "What is Black Badger's appearance like?

units.zh: 高相作何經略？」
units.en: What strategy does Chancellor Gao pursue?"
units.literal: What strategy does Chancellor Gao pursue?"

units.zh: 繪曰：「黑獺遊魂關右，人神厭毒，連歲凶災，百姓懷土。
units.en: Hui said, "Black Badger is a stray spirit in the west, loathed by men and spirits alike; year after year brings fierce calamity and the people yearn for their homeland.
units.literal: Hui said: "Black Badger is a stray spirit in the west, loathed by men and spirits alike; year after year brings fierce calamity and the people yearn for their homeland.

units.zh: 丞相奇略不世，畜銳觀釁，攻昧取亡，勢必不遠。」
units.en: The chancellor's stratagems are unmatched in the age; he gathers sharp blades and watches for an opening — attacking the benighted to take the doomed — victory cannot be far."
units.literal: The chancellor's stratagems are unmatched in the age; he gathers sharp blades and watches for an opening — attacking the benighted to take the doomed — victory cannot be far."

units.zh: 梁武曰：「如卿言極佳。」
units.en: Emperor Wu said, "As you say — excellent."
units.literal: Emperor Wu said: "As you say — excellent."

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 繪曰：「兄所出雖遠，當共車千秋分一字耳。」
units.en: Hui said, "Though what you issue from is remote, you should share one character with Che Qianqiu."
units.literal: Hui said: "Though what you issue from is remote, you should share one character with Che Qianqiu."

units.zh: 一坐大笑。
units.en: The whole company laughed aloud.
units.literal: The whole company laughed aloud.

units.zh: 前後行人，皆通啟求市，繪獨守清尚，梁人重其廉潔。
units.en: Envoys who came before and after all sent letters opening relations and seeking trade; Hui alone kept to purity and loftiness — the men of Liang respected his integrity.
units.literal: Envoys who came before and after all sent letters opening relations and seeking trade; Hui alone kept to purity and loftiness — the men of Liang respected his integrity.

units.zh: 使還，拜平南將軍、高陽內史。
units.en: On his return he was appointed general who pacifies the south and inner administrator of Gaoyang.
units.literal: On his return he was appointed general who pacifies the south and inner administrator of Gaoyang.

units.zh: 郡境舊有猛獸，民常患之。
units.en: Within the commandery there had long been fierce beasts; the people often suffered from them.
units.literal: Within the commandery there had long been fierce beasts; the people often suffered from them.

units.zh: 繪欲修檻，遂因鬬死。
units.en: Hui wished to build a cage-trap; the beast thereupon died in a fight.
units.literal: Hui wished to build a cage-trap; the beast thereupon died in a fight.

units.zh: 咸以為化感所致，皆請申上。
units.en: All considered it an effect of transforming influence and asked to report it upward.
units.literal: All considered it an effect of transforming influence and asked to report it upward.

units.zh: 繪曰：「猛獸因鬥而斃，自是偶然，貪此為功，人將窺我。」
units.en: Hui said, "The fierce beast died fighting — that was mere chance; if I greedily claim it as merit, people will peer into me."
units.literal: Hui said: "The fierce beast died fighting — that was mere chance; if I greedily claim it as merit, people will peer into me."

units.zh: 竟不聽。
units.en: In the end he would not listen.
units.literal: In the end he would not listen.

units.zh: 高祖東巡郡國，在瀛州城西駐馬久立，使慰之曰：「孤在晉，知山東守唯卿一人用意。
units.en: Gao Huan toured the commanderies eastward; west of Yingzhou city he halted his horse and stood long; he sent word of comfort, "When I was in Jin, I knew that among the governors east of the mountains only you alone applied your mind.
units.literal: Gao Huan toured the commanderies eastward; west of Yingzhou city he halted his horse and stood long; he sent word of comfort: "When I was in Jin, I knew that among the governors east of the mountains only you alone applied your mind.

units.zh: 及入境觀風，信如所聞。
units.en: Now that I have entered your territory and observed the winds, it is as I heard.
units.literal: Now that I have entered your territory and observed the winds, it is as I heard.

units.zh: 但善始令終，將位至不次。」
units.en: Only see that you begin well and end well — your rank will rise beyond the ordinary."
units.literal: Only see that you begin well and end well — your rank will rise beyond the ordinary."

units.zh: 河間守崔謀恃其弟暹勢，從繪乞麋角鴿羽。
units.en: Administrator of Hejian Cui Mou relied on the power of his younger brother Xian and begged from Hui elk horns and pigeon feathers.
units.literal: Administrator of Hejian Cui Mou relied on the power of his younger brother Xian and begged from Hui elk horns and pigeon feathers.

units.zh: 繪答書曰：「鴿有六翮，飛則沖天，麋有四足，走便入海。
units.en: Hui replied in a letter, "The pigeon has six pinions — in flight it pierces the sky; the elk has four legs — in running it soon reaches the sea.
units.literal: Hui replied in a letter: "The pigeon has six pinions — in flight it pierces the sky; the elk has four legs — in running it soon reaches the sea.

units.zh: 下官膚體疏懶，手足遲鈍，不能逐飛追走，遠事佞人。」
units.en: This humble officer's flesh is slack and lazy, his hands and feet slow and dull; I cannot chase what flies or pursue what runs, and go far to serve a flatterer."
units.literal: This humble officer's flesh is slack and lazy, his hands and feet slow and dull; I cannot chase what flies or pursue what runs, and go far to serve a flatterer."

units.zh: 是時世宗使暹選司徒長史，暹薦繪，旣而不果，咸謂由此書。
units.en: At the time Gao Cheng had Xian select the chief clerk of the Minister over the Masses; Xian recommended Hui, but in the end it did not come to pass — all said it was because of this letter.
units.literal: At the time Gao Cheng had Xian select the chief clerk of the Minister over the Masses; Xian recommended Hui, but in the end it did not come to pass — all said it was because of this letter.

units.zh: 天保初，為司徒右長史。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao he was chief clerk on the right of the Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was chief clerk on the right of the Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 繪質性方重，未嘗趨事權勢，以此久而屈沈。
units.en: Hui's nature was square and weighty; he never hurried to serve the powerful — for this reason he long remained suppressed and obscure.
units.literal: Hui's nature was square and weighty; he never hurried to serve the powerful — for this reason he long remained suppressed and obscure.

units.zh: 卒。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 贈南青州刺史，謚曰景。
units.en: He was posthumously made governor of Southern Qingzhou; his posthumous title was Jing.
units.literal: He was posthumously made governor of Southern Qingzhou; his posthumous title was Jing.

units.zh: 公緒，字穆叔，渾族兄籍之子。
units.en: Gongxu, styled Mushu, was the son of Ji, Hun's clansman on the elder-brother line.
units.literal: Gongxu, styled Mushu, was the son of Ji, Hun's clansman elder brother.

units.zh: 性聰敏，博通經傳。
units.en: By nature clever and keen, he broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries.
units.literal: By nature clever and keen, he broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries.

units.zh: 魏末冀州司馬，屬疾去官。
units.en: At the end of Wei he was staff officer in Jizhou; he left office on grounds of illness.
units.literal: At the end of Wei he was staff officer in Jizhou; he left office on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 後以侍御史徵，不至，卒。
units.en: Later he was summoned as attendant censor but did not come; he died.
units.literal: Later he was summoned as attendant censor but did not come; he died.

units.zh: 公緒沉冥樂道，不關世務，故誓心不仕。
units.en: Gongxu was withdrawn and delighted in the Way, heedless of worldly affairs — hence he vowed in his heart not to serve.
units.literal: Gongxu was withdrawn and delighted in the Way, heedless of worldly affairs — hence he vowed in his heart not to serve.

units.zh: 尤善陰陽圖緯之學。
units.en: He was especially skilled in yin-yang lore and apocryphal charts.
units.literal: He was especially skilled in yin-yang lore and apocryphal charts.

units.zh: 嘗語人云：「吾每觀齊之分野，福德不多，國家世祚，終於四七。」
units.en: He once told people, "Whenever I observe the astral territory of Qi, its fortune and virtue are not great; the state's dynastic span will end at four-seven."
units.literal: He once told people: "Whenever I observe the astral territory of Qi, its fortune and virtue are not great; the state's dynastic span will end at four-seven."

units.zh: 及齊亡之歲，上距天保之元二十八年矣。
units.en: When Qi fell, it was twenty-eight years from the first year of Tianbao.
units.literal: When Qi fell, it was twenty-eight years from the first year of Tianbao.

units.zh: 公緒潛居自待，雅好著書，撰《典言》十卷，又撰《質疑》五卷，《喪服章句》一卷，《古今略記》二十卷，《玄子》五卷，《趙語》十三卷，並行於世。
units.en: Gongxu lived in seclusion awaiting his time and by nature loved to write books; he composed Dianyan in ten juan, also Zhiyi in five juan, Sangfu zhangju in one juan, Gujin lüeji in twenty juan, Xuanzi in five juan, and Zhaoyu in thirteen juan — all circulated in the world.
units.literal: Gongxu lived in seclusion awaiting his time and by nature loved to write books; he composed Dianyan in ten juan, also composed Zhiyi in five juan, Sangfu zhangju in one juan, Gujin lüeji in twenty juan, Xuanzi in five juan, and Zhaoyu in thirteen juan — all circulated in the world.

units.zh: 李璵，字道璠，隴西成紀人，涼武昭王暠之五世孫。
units.en: Li Yu, styled Daofan, was a man of Chengji in Longxi — fifth-generation descendant of Li Hao, Martial and Illustrious King of Liang.
units.literal: Li Yu, styled Daofan, was a man of Chengji in Longxi — fifth-generation descendant of Li Hao, Martial and Illustrious King of Liang.

units.zh: 父韶，並有重名於魏代。
units.en: His father Shao; both father and son won great renown in Wei.
units.literal: His father Shao — both had great fame in the Wei age.

units.zh: 璵溫雅有識量。
units.en: Yu was mild and refined, with judgment and breadth of mind.
units.literal: Yu was mild and refined, with discernment and capacity.

units.zh: 釋褐太尉行參軍，累遷司徒右長史。
units.en: Upon removing mourning he entered service as staff officer to the grand commandant and rose in turn to right chief clerk of the secretariat.
units.literal: Upon removing mourning he became a staff officer in the Grand Commandant's office and rose in succession to right chief clerk of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 及遷都於鄴，留於後，監掌府藏，及撤運宮廟材木，以明幹見稱。
units.en: When the capital moved to Ye he stayed behind to oversee the treasury and haul palace and temple timber — and was praised for sharp, capable work.
units.literal: When the capital was moved to Ye, he remained behind to oversee the treasury and to transport timber from palace and temple; he was known for clarity and competence.

units.zh: 累遷驃騎大將軍、東徐州刺史。
units.en: He rose in turn to rapid cavalry grand general and inspector of eastern Xu province.
units.literal: He rose in succession to Rapid Cavalry Grand General and inspector of Eastern Xu Province.

units.zh: 解州還，遂稱老疾，不求仕。
units.en: On leaving his post he went home, pleaded old age and illness, and sought no further office.
units.literal: When he left his post and returned, he claimed old age and illness and sought no further office.

units.zh: 齊受禪，進璵兼前將軍，導從於圓丘行禮。
units.en: When Qi received the mandate, Yu was promoted to former general concurrently and led the rites at the Round Mound.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, Yu was advanced to former general concurrently and guided the rites at the Round Mound.

units.zh: 璵意不願策名兩朝，雖以宿舊被徵，過事卽絕朝請。
units.en: Yu would not have his name entered in two dynasties; though summoned as an old friend, once the rite was done he ceased all court attendance.
units.literal: Yu did not wish to register his name in two dynasties; though summoned as an old acquaintance, once the affair was over he ceased court attendance.

units.zh: 天保四年卒。
units.en: He died in the fourth year of Tianbao.
units.literal: He died in the fourth year of Tianbao.

units.zh: 子詮、韞、誦。
units.en: His sons were Quan, Yun, and Song.
units.literal: His sons were Quan, Yun, and Song.

units.zh: 韞無行。
units.en: Yun was without conduct.
units.literal: Yun was without conduct.

units.zh: 誦以女妻穆提婆子懷廆，超遷臨漳令、儀同三司。
units.en: Song gave his daughter to Huai'ao, son of Mu Tipo, and was promoted beyond measure to magistrate of Linzhang and equal in three departments.
units.literal: Song gave his daughter in marriage to Huai'ao, son of Mu Tipo, and was promoted beyond measure to magistrate of Linzhang and equal in three departments.

units.zh: 韞與陸令萱女弟私通，令萱奏授太子舍人。
units.en: Yun carried on with Lu Lingxuan's younger sister; Lingxuan memorialized and had him made crown prince attendant.
units.literal: Yun had illicit relations with the younger sister of Lu Lingxuan; Lingxuan memorialized to appoint him crown prince attendant.

units.zh: 弟瑾，字道瑜，名在《魏書》。
units.en: His younger brother Jin, styled Daoyu, is famed in the Book of Wei.
units.literal: His younger brother Jin, styled Daoyu, whose fame is recorded in the Book of Wei.

units.zh: 才識之美，見稱當代。
units.en: His talent and learning won praise in his age.
units.literal: His talent and learning were praised in his age.

units.zh: 瑾六子，彥之、倩之、壽之、禮之、行之、凝之，並有器望。
units.en: Jin had six sons — Yanzhi, Qianzhi, Shouzhi, Lizhi, Xingzhi, and Ningzhi — all men of talent and standing.
units.literal: Jin had six sons — Yanzhi, Qianzhi, Shouzhi, Lizhi, Xingzhi, and Ningzhi — all with talent and repute.

units.zh: 行之與兄弟深相友愛，又風素夷簡，為士友所稱。
units.en: Xingzhi loved his brothers deeply; plain and unassuming in manner, he was praised by men of letters.
units.literal: Xingzhi was deeply affectionate with his brothers; moreover he was plain and simple in manner, and scholar-friends praised him.

units.zh: 范陽盧思道是其舅子，嘗贈詩云：「水衡稱逸人，潘楊有世親，形骸預冠蓋，心思出風塵。」
units.en: Lu Sidao of Fan Yang was his nephew by marriage; once he sent a poem: "The Director of Water Balances calls him a recluse; Pan and Yang are kin by marriage through the generations; his body already rides with caps and coaches, yet his mind ranges beyond the dust of the world."
units.literal: Fan Yang's Lu Sidao was his nephew by marriage; once he presented a poem saying: "The Director of Water Balances calls him a recluse; Pan and Yang have a marriage tie of generations; his body already shares caps and coaches, yet his mind ranges beyond the dust of the world."

units.zh: 時人以為實錄。
units.en: Men of the time took this for truth.
units.literal: Men of the time took this as an accurate record.

units.zh: 璵從弟曉，字仁略。
units.en: Yu's cousin Xiao, styled Renlue.
units.literal: Yu's cousin Xiao, styled Renlue.

units.zh: 魏太尉虔子。
units.en: He was a son of Wei grand commandant Qian.
units.literal: He was a son of Wei Grand Commandant Qian.

units.zh: 學涉有思理。
units.en: Broad in learning, with a keen mind.
units.literal: Broad in learning, with power of thought.

units.zh: 釋褐員外侍郎。
units.en: Upon removing mourning he became an outer secretariat attendant.
units.literal: Upon removing mourning he became an outer secretariat attendant.

units.zh: 尒朱榮之害朝士，將行，曉衣冠為鼠所噬，遂不成行，得免河陰之難。
units.en: When Erzhu Rong was about to slaughter the court gentlemen and Xiao was to go, rats gnawed his robe and cap; he could not set out and so escaped the disaster at Heyin.
units.literal: When Erzhu Rong was about to harm the court gentlemen and Xiao was to go, rats gnawed his robe and cap; he could not go and so escaped the disaster at Heyin.

units.zh: 及遷都鄴，曉便寓居清河，託從母兄崔悛宅。
units.en: When the capital moved to Ye, Xiao lodged in Qinghe at the home of his mother's sister's son, Cui Juan.
units.literal: When the capital moved to Ye, Xiao lodged in Qinghe and entrusted himself to his mother's sister's son Cui Juan's house.

units.zh: 給良田三十頃，曉遂築室安居，訓勗子侄，無復宦情。
units.en: He was granted thirty qing of fertile land; Xiao built a house, settled in peace, and schooled his nephews — with no further wish for office.
units.literal: He was granted thirty qing of fertile fields; Xiao then built a house and dwelt at ease, instructing and urging his nephews, with no further desire for office.

units.zh: 武定末，以世道方泰，乃入都從仕。
units.en: At the end of Wuding, seeing the age at peace, he entered the capital to serve.
units.literal: At the end of Wuding, seeing the age was at peace, he entered the capital to take office.

units.zh: 除頓丘守，卒。
units.en: He was made magistrate of Dunqiu and died in office.
units.literal: He was made magistrate of Dunqiu and died in office.

units.zh: 鄭述祖，字恭文，滎陽開封人。
units.en: Zheng Shuzu, styled Gongwen, was a man of Kaifeng in Xingyang.
units.literal: Zheng Shuzu, styled Gongwen, was a man of Kaifeng in Xingyang.

units.zh: 祖羲，魏中書令。
units.en: His grandfather Xi was Wei director of the secretariat.
units.literal: His grandfather Xi was Wei director of the secretariat.

units.zh: 父道昭，魏秘書監。
units.en: His father Daozhao was Wei secretariat supervisor.
units.literal: His father Daozhao was Wei secretariat supervisor.

units.zh: 述祖少聰敏，好屬文，有風檢，為先達所稱譽。
units.en: Shuzu in youth was clever and quick, loved to write, bore himself with restraint, and won praise from elders.
units.literal: Shuzu in youth was clever and keen, loved literary composition, had moral bearing, and was praised by elders of the age.

units.zh: 釋褐司空行參軍。
units.en: Upon removing mourning he entered service as staff officer in the ministry of works.
units.literal: Upon removing mourning he became a staff officer in the Ministry of Works.

units.zh: 天保初，累遷太子少師、儀同三司、兗州刺史。
units.en: At the opening of Tianbao he rose in turn to junior tutor of the crown prince, equal in three departments, and inspector of Yan province.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he rose in succession to junior tutor of the crown prince, equal in three departments, and inspector of Yan Province.

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 今於鄭兗州見之矣。」
units.en: Today I have seen it in Inspector Zheng of Yan province."
units.literal: Today I have seen it in Inspector Zheng of Yan Province."

units.zh: 初，述祖父為光州，於城南小山起齋亭，刻石為記。
units.en: Earlier, when Shuzu's father held Guang province, he built a chapel on a hill south of the city and carved a stone inscription.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shuzu's father was at Guang Province, he built a chapel pavilion on a small hill south of the city and carved a stone inscription.

units.zh: 述祖時年九歲。
units.en: Shuzu was then nine years old.
units.literal: Shuzu was then nine years old.

units.zh: 及為刺史，往尋舊跡，得一破石，有銘云：「中嶽先生鄭道昭之白雲堂。」
units.en: When he became inspector he went to seek the old site and found a broken stone inscribed: "The White Cloud Hall of Zheng Daozhao, Mr. Zhongyue."
units.literal: When he became inspector he went to seek the old site and found a broken stone with an inscription reading: "The White Cloud Hall of Zheng Daozhao, Mr. Zhongyue."

units.zh: 述祖對之嗚咽，悲動群僚。
units.en: Shuzu faced it and sobbed aloud; his grief moved the whole staff.
units.literal: Shuzu faced it and sobbed; his grief moved the whole staff.

units.zh: 有人入市盜布，其父怒曰：「何忍欺人君！」
units.en: Someone in the market stole cloth; his father said in anger, "How can you bear to cheat the ruler!"
units.literal: Someone in the market stole cloth; his father said in anger: "How can you bear to cheat the ruler!"

units.zh: 執之以歸首，述祖特原之。
units.en: He seized the man and handed him over; Shuzu especially pardoned him.
units.literal: He seized the man and handed him over; Shuzu especially pardoned him.

units.zh: 自是之後，境內無盜。
units.en: From then on there were no thieves within the borders.
units.literal: From then on there were no thieves within the borders.

units.zh: 人歌之曰：「大鄭公，小鄭公，相去五十載，風教猶尚同。」
units.en: The people sang: "Great Duke Zheng, little Duke Zheng — fifty years apart, yet their teaching and customs are still one."
units.literal: The people sang of them: "Great Duke Zheng, little Duke Zheng — fifty years apart, yet their teaching and customs are still the same."

units.zh: 述祖能鼓琴，自造《龍吟十弄》，云嘗夢人彈琴，寤而寫得。
units.en: Shuzu could play the zither and himself composed the "Dragon Chant, Ten Pieces," saying he once dreamed a man playing the zither and on waking wrote it down.
units.literal: Shuzu could play the zither and himself composed the "Dragon Chant, Ten Pieces," saying that once he dreamed a man played the zither and on waking wrote it down.

units.zh: 當時以為絕妙。
units.en: Men of the time held it matchless.
units.literal: Men of the time held it matchless.

units.zh: 所在好為山池，松竹交植。
units.en: Wherever he served he loved to lay out hills and pools, planting pine and bamboo together.
units.literal: Wherever he was posted he loved to make hills and pools, with pine and bamboo planted together.

units.zh: 盛饌以待賓客，將迎不倦。
units.en: He set out rich fare for guests and never tired of welcoming them.
units.literal: He set out rich fare for guests and never tired of receiving them.

units.zh: 未貴時，在鄉單馬出行，忽有騎者數百，見述祖皆下馬，曰「公在此」，行列而拜。
units.en: Before he rose to honor, riding alone in the countryside, suddenly several hundred horsemen appeared; seeing Shuzu they all dismounted and said, "The lord is here," then lined up and bowed.
units.literal: Before he rose to honor, riding alone in the countryside, suddenly several hundred horsemen appeared; seeing Shuzu they all dismounted and said, "The lord is here," then lined up and bowed.

units.zh: 述祖顧問從人，皆不見，心甚異之。
units.en: Shuzu turned to ask his attendants; none had seen them. His heart was deeply struck.
units.literal: Shuzu turned to ask his attendants; none had seen them. His heart was deeply struck.

units.zh: 未幾備徵，終歷顯位。
units.en: Before long he was summoned to court and in the end held eminent rank.
units.literal: Before long he was summoned to court and in the end held eminent rank.

units.zh: 及病篤，乃自言之。
units.en: When gravely ill he spoke of this himself.
units.literal: When gravely ill he spoke of this himself.

units.zh: 且曰：「吾今老矣，一生富貴足矣，以清白之名遺子孫，死無所恨。」
units.en: He also said, "I am old now; a lifetime of wealth and honor is enough. To leave my descendants a name for integrity — in death I have no regret."
units.literal: He also said: "I am old now; a lifetime of wealth and honor is enough. To leave a name of integrity to my descendants — in death I have no regret."

units.zh: 遂卒於州。
units.en: He then died in the province.
units.literal: He then died in the province.

units.zh: 述祖女為趙郡王叡妃。
units.en: Shuzu's daughter was consort to Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui.
units.literal: Shuzu's daughter was consort to Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui.

units.zh: 述祖常坐受王拜，命坐，王乃坐。
units.en: Shuzu would sit and receive the prince's bow; only when Shuzu bade him sit would the prince sit.
units.literal: Shuzu would sit and receive the prince's bow; only when he ordered him to sit would the prince sit.

units.zh: 妃薨後，王更娶鄭道蔭女。
units.en: After the consort died, the prince took Zheng Daoyin's daughter in marriage.
units.literal: After the consort died, the prince took Zheng Daoyin's daughter in marriage.

units.zh: 王坐受道蔭拜，王命坐，乃敢坐。
units.en: The prince would sit and receive Daoyin's bow; the prince ordered him to sit, and only then did Daoyin dare sit.
units.literal: The prince would sit and receive Daoyin's bow; the prince ordered him to sit, and only then did he dare sit.

units.zh: 王謂道蔭曰：「鄭尚書風德如此，又貴重宿舊，君不得譬之。」
units.en: The prince said to Daoyin, "Minister Zheng's bearing and virtue are such, and he is moreover an honored elder of long standing — you must not compare yourself to him."
units.literal: The prince said to Daoyin: "Minister Zheng's bearing and virtue are such, and he is moreover a honored elder of long standing — you must not compare yourself to him."

units.zh: 子元德，多藝術，官至瑯邪守。
units.en: His son Yuande was skilled in many arts and rose to governor of Langye.
units.literal: His son Yuande was skilled in many arts and reached the post of governor of Langye.

units.zh: 元德從父弟元禮，字文規。
units.en: Yuande's cousin Yuan Li, styled Wengui.
units.literal: Yuande's cousin Yuan Li, styled Wengui.

units.zh: 少好學，愛文藻，有名望。
units.en: In youth he loved learning and prized literary ornament; he had fame and standing.
units.literal: In youth he loved learning and prized literary ornament; he had fame and standing.

units.zh: 世宗引為館客，歷太子舍人。
units.en: Gao Cheng retained him as retainer-guest; he served in turn as crown prince attendant.
units.literal: Gao Cheng retained him as a retainer-guest and he served in succession as crown prince attendant.

units.zh: 崔昂妻，卽元禮之姊也，魏收又昂之妹夫。
units.en: Cui Ang's wife was Yuan Li's elder sister; Wei Shou was also Ang's brother-in-law.
units.literal: Cui Ang's wife was Yuan Li's elder sister; Wei Shou was also Ang's brother-in-law.

units.zh: 昂嘗持元禮數篇詩示盧思道，乃謂思道云：「看元禮比來詩詠，亦當不減魏收？」
units.en: Ang once showed several of Yuan Li's poems to Lu Sidao and said, "Look at Yuan Li's recent poems — are they not the equal of Wei Shou?"
units.literal: Ang once showed several of Yuan Li's poems to Lu Sidao and said to Sidao: "Look at Yuan Li's recent poems — are they not the equal of Wei Shou?"

units.zh: 答云：「未覺元禮賢於魏收，但知妹夫疏於婦弟。」
units.en: He answered, "I do not feel Yuan Li is better than Wei Shou — I only know a brother-in-law is cold to his wife's brother."
units.literal: He answered: "I do not feel Yuan Li is better than Wei Shou — I only know a brother-in-law is cold to his wife's brother."

units.zh: 元禮入周，卒於始州別駕。
units.en: Yuan Li entered Zhou and died as vice governor of Shi prefecture.
units.literal: Yuan Li entered Zhou and died as vice governor of Shi Prefecture.

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 初，文宣命邢卲制帝名殷，字正道，帝從而尤之曰：「殷家弟及，『正』字一止，吾身後兒不得也。」
units.en: Earlier, Emperor Wenxuan had ordered Xing Shao to devise Yin as the emperor's personal name and Zhengdao as his style. Wenxuan later faulted him for it: "In the house of Yin, brothers succeeded one another, and the character 正 contains a single 'stop.' After I am gone, my son will not have it."
units.literal: Initially, Emperor Wenxuan ordered Xing Shao to devise the emperor's personal name Yin and style Zhengdao; the emperor then faulted him, saying, "In the house of Yin, younger brothers succeeded; the character zheng contains one stop, so after I am gone my son will not get it."

units.zh: 卲懼，請改焉。
units.en: Shao was frightened and asked to change the names.
units.literal: Shao was afraid and asked to change it.

units.zh: 從行臺蕭寶寅討破宛川，俘其民人為奴婢，以美女十人賞蘭根。
units.en: Following Mobile Headquarters Xiao Baoyin, he helped defeat Wanchuan. Captives were made slaves; ten fair women were awarded to Langen as his prize.
units.literal: Following Mobile Headquarters Xiao Baoyin, he defeated Wanchuan; the captive populace were made slaves and bondmaids, and ten fair women were awarded to Langen as reward.

units.zh: 屬秦隴反叛，蕭寶寅敗於涇州，高平虜賊逼岐州，州城民逼囚蘭根降賊。
units.en: When Qin and Long rose in rebellion, Xiao Baoyin was defeated at Jing Province. Gaoping barbarian bandits pressed Qi Province, and townsfolk forced Langen into captivity to surrender to the rebels.
units.literal: As Qin and Long rebelled, Xiao Baoyin was defeated at Jing Province; barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province, and the townsfolk forced and imprisoned Langen to surrender to the rebels.

units.zh: 寶寅至雍州，收輯散亡，兵威復振，城民復斬賊刺史侯莫陳仲和，推蘭根復任。
units.en: Baoyin reached Yong Province, gathered scattered troops, and military prestige revived. The townsfolk beheaded the rebel inspector Hou Mo-Chen Zhonghe and urged Langen to resume office.
units.literal: Baoyin reached Yong Province, gathered scattered troops, and military prestige revived; the townsfolk again beheaded the rebel inspector Hou Mo-Chen Zhonghe and urged Langen to resume his post.

units.zh: 周文東至崤、陜，遣其行臺侯莫陳崇自齊子嶺趣軹關，儀同楊檦從鼓鐘道出建州，陷孤公戍。
units.en: Yuwen Tai marched east to Xiao and Shan, sending field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge against Zhiguan Pass while yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road into Jian Province captured the Gugong garrison.
units.literal: Zhou Wen marched east to Xiao and Shan, dispatching his field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge toward Zhiguan, while Yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road out toward Jian Province captured Gugong garrison.

units.zh: 齊高祖神武皇帝，姓高名歡，字賀六渾，渤海蓚人也。
units.en: Gaozu Emperor Shenwu of Northern Qi bore the surname Gao; his personal name was Huan and his style Heiliuhun. He came from Tiao in Bohai.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor of Qi, Emperor Shenwu, surname Gao, taboo name Huan, style name Heiliuhun, was a native of Tiao in Bohai.

units.zh: 神武上
units.en: Emperor Shenwu, Part One
units.literal: Emperor Shenwu, Part One

units.zh: 家貧，及聘武明皇后，始有馬，得給鎮為隊主。
units.en: The family was poor, and only after he betrothed Lady Wuming did he acquire a horse and win appointment as squad chief at the garrison.
units.literal: His family was poor; only when he betrothed Empress Wuming did he first have a horse and was able to serve the garrison as squad chief.

units.zh: 神武自隊主轉為函使。
units.en: Gao Huan moved from squad chief to garrison courier.
units.literal: Shenwu advanced from squad chief to courier.

units.zh: 自是乃有澄清天下之志。
units.en: From that day he resolved to set the realm right.
units.literal: From this time he nursed the ambition to cleanse and clarify the realm.

units.zh: 神武旣累世北邊，故習其俗，遂同鮮卑。
units.en: For generations his family had lived on the northern marches, so Gao Huan grew up in frontier ways and lived much like the Xianbei.
units.literal: As for generations his family had been on the northern frontier, Shenwu was accustomed to its customs and came to be as the Xianbei.

units.zh: 六世祖隱，晉玄菟太守。
units.en: In the sixth generation his ancestor Yin had been Administrator of Xuantu under the Jin.
units.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Yin served as Administrator of Xuantu under Jin.

units.zh: 湖生四子，第三子謐，仕魏，位至侍御史，坐法徙居懷朔鎮。
units.en: Hu had four sons. The third, Mi, served the Wei court and rose to Attending Censor, but after a legal infraction was banished to live at Huaishuo garrison.
units.literal: Hu had four sons; the third, Mi, served Wei, rose to Attending Censor, and for violating the law was exiled to garrison at Huaishuo.

units.zh: 嘗乘驛過建興，雲霧晝晦，雷聲隨之，半日乃絕，若有神應者。
units.en: Once while riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day and thunder rolled after him for half a day, as though heaven itself were answering his passage.
units.literal: Once riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day, thunder followed along, and for half a day it did not cease — as if there were a divine response.

units.zh: 為函使六年，每至洛陽，給令史麻祥使。
units.en: For six years as courier he went each time to Luoyang, where he was assigned to the clerk Ma Xiang.
units.literal: For six years as courier, whenever he reached Luoyang he was detailed to the clerk Ma Xiang.

units.zh: 及自洛陽還，傾產以結客。
units.en: On his return from Luoyang he poured out his fortune to gather followers.
units.literal: When he returned from Luoyang, he expended his whole estate to gather clients.

units.zh: 親故怪問之，答曰：「吾至洛陽，宿衛羽林相率焚領軍張彝宅，朝廷懼其亂而不問。
units.en: Kinsmen and friends asked what moved him; he answered, "At Luoyang I saw the Feathered Forest guards burn down the residence of Supreme Commander Zhang Yi in a mob, and the court, fearing worse trouble, never punished them.
units.literal: Relatives and friends wondered and asked him; he replied: "When I reached Luoyang, the palace guards of the Feathered Forest together burned the residence of the supreme commander Zhang Yi, and the court feared their disorder and did not inquire.

units.zh: 見一赤兔，每搏輒逸，遂至回澤。
units.en: They sighted a russet hare that bolted away whenever they closed, and the chase carried them to Huize Marsh.
units.literal: They saw a red hare; each time they closed in it escaped, and they went on as far as Huize Marsh.

units.zh: 澤中有茅屋，將奔入，有狗自屋中出，噬之，鷹兔俱死。
units.en: Near a hut on the marsh the hare was nearly inside when a dog rushed out, tore at it, and killed both hawk and hare.
units.literal: In the marsh there was a thatched hut; as the hare was about to flee into it, a dog came out from the hut and bit it, and hawk and hare both died.

units.zh: 鎮將遼西段長常奇神武貌，謂曰：「君有康濟才，終不徒然。」
units.en: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, the garrison commander, often admired Gao Huan's looks and told him, "You have the talent to heal the realm; you will not end your days obscurely."
units.literal: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, commander of the garrison, often marveled at Shenwu's appearance and said to him: "You possess talent for bringing order and succor; you will not in the end come to nothing."

units.zh: 便以子孫為托。
units.en: And he entrusted his descendants to Gao Huan's care.
units.literal: He thereupon entrusted him with his descendants.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 劉貴嘗得一白鷹，與神武及尉景、蔡儁、子如、賈顯智等獵於沃野。
units.en: Liu Gui once came by a white hawk and went hunting on the open steppe with Gao Huan, Wei Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and the rest.
units.literal: Liu Gui once obtained a white hawk and hunted on the open fields with Shenwu, Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and others.

units.zh: 及神武生而皇妣韓氏殂，養於同產姊婿鎮獄隊尉景家。
units.en: When Gao Huan was born his mother Lady Han died, and he was reared in the household of his full elder sister's husband Wei Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.
units.literal: When Shenwu was born the late mother Lady Han died, and he was raised in the home of his uterine elder sister's husband, Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.

units.zh: 長而深沉有大度，輕財重士，為豪俠所宗。
units.en: As a man he was reserved and far-sighted, generous with money and devoted to worthy companions, and the local men of daring looked to him as their leader.
units.literal: When grown he was deep and reserved, possessed of great breadth of mind, lightly regarded wealth and valued men of talent, and was looked to by bold heroes.

units.zh: 目有精光，長頭高顴，齒白如玉，少有人傑表。
units.en: His eyes gleamed, his head was long and his cheekbones high, his teeth white as jade; even in youth he wore the bearing of a man marked for greatness.
units.literal: His eyes had a sharp brilliance; his head was long and cheeks high; his teeth white as jade — in youth he had the countenance of an uncommon man.

units.zh: 詳嘗以肉啖神武，神武性不立食，坐而進之。
units.en: Xiang once fed him meat; Gao Huan, who never ate standing, sat down to accept it.
units.literal: Xiang once offered meat to Shenwu to eat; Shenwu by nature would not eat standing, and so sat to receive it.

units.zh: 因自言善暗相，遍捫諸人皆貴，而指麾俱由神武。
units.en: Declaring herself skilled in reading fate by touch, she passed her hands over each man and pronounced them all destined for rank, yet said every fortune turned on Gao Huan.
units.literal: She then said herself that she was skilled at reading fortune by touch; she felt over everyone and found them all noble, yet all destinies depended on Shenwu's direction.

units.zh: 由是諸人益加敬異。
units.en: From that day his companions held him in still greater awe.
units.literal: From this the company all the more revered and marvelled at him.

units.zh: 為政若此，事可知也。
units.en: When government runs thus, the course of events is already clear.
units.literal: When government is like this, how affairs will turn out is plain to see.

units.zh: 財物豈可常守邪？」
units.en: What good is clinging to property forever?"
units.literal: Can wealth and goods be kept forever?"

units.zh: 又嘗夢履衆星而行，覺而內喜。
units.en: He also dreamed once that he walked treading upon the stars; when he woke he was secretly elated.
units.literal: Again he once dreamed of treading among the stars as he walked; waking, he rejoiced inwardly.

units.zh: 祥以為慢己，笞神武四十。
units.en: Xiang took this as an insult and had Gao Huan beaten forty strokes.
units.literal: Xiang took this as disrespect toward himself and had Shenwu flogged forty strokes.

units.zh: 神武怒，以鳴鏑射之，狗斃。
units.en: Gao Huan, furious, killed the dog with a whistling arrow.
units.literal: Shenwu in anger shot it with a whistling arrow and killed the dog.

units.zh: 飯竟出，行數里還，更訪之，則本無人居，乃向非人也。
units.en: After the meal they rode on, but a few li later turned back to find the place, and there was no hut at all—their hosts had not been of this world.
units.literal: When the meal was done they left; after going several li they turned back to visit again, but where there had been no dwelling at all — those before had not been human.

units.zh: 每行道路，往來無風塵之色。
units.en: Whenever he traveled the roads he seemed untouched by wind and dust.
units.literal: Whenever he traveled the roads, there was no look of wind and dust about his coming and going.

units.zh: 及貴，追贈長司空，擢其子寧用之。
units.en: After Gao Huan rose to power he posthumously honored Duan Chang with the title Minister of Works and brought his son Ning into office.
units.literal: When Shenwu rose high, he posthumously enfeoffed Chang as Minister of Works and promoted his son Ning to employment.

units.zh: 屋中有二人出，持神武襟甚急。
units.en: Two men burst from the hut and seized Gao Huan's robe in alarm.
units.literal: Two men came out from the hut and seized Shenwu's robe with great urgency.

units.zh: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。
units.en: Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was made Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was appointed Concurrent Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 己卯，兼右僕射魏收以阿縱除名。
units.en: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.
units.literal: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.

units.zh: 遂奔葛榮，又亡歸尒朱榮於秀容。
units.en: He fled next to Ge Rong, then broke away again and took refuge with Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.
units.literal: He then fled to Ge Rong, and again broke away and returned to Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.

units.zh: 先是，劉貴事榮，盛言神武美，至是始得見，以憔悴故，未之奇也。
units.en: Liu Gui had long served Erzhu Rong and spoken lavishly of Gao Huan's gifts; now Gao Huan finally met Rong face to face, but worn and haggard as he was, Rong saw nothing remarkable in him.
units.literal: Earlier Liu Gui had served Rong and lavishly praised Shenwu's excellence; only now did he first gain an audience, but because he was haggard, Rong did not regard him as extraordinary.

units.zh: 旣而榮以神武為親信都督。
units.en: Soon after, Erzhu Rong appointed Gao Huan trusted commander.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter Rong made Shenwu trusted commander.

units.zh: 于於時魏明帝銜鄭儼、徐紇，逼靈太后，未敢制，私使榮舉兵內向。
units.en: At that time Emperor Ming of Northern Wei loathed Zheng Yan and Xu He, who dominated Empress Dowager Ling, but dared not move against them openly; he secretly urged Erzhu Rong to march on the capital.
units.literal: At this time Wei Emperor Ming bore hatred for Zheng Yan and Xu He, who pressed the Empress Dowager Ling; he dared not restrain them and secretly sent Rong to raise troops inward.

units.zh: 及尒朱榮擊葛榮，令神武喻下賊別稱王者七人。
units.en: When Erzhu Rong campaigned against Ge Rong, he sent Gao Huan to talk seven rebel kings into surrender.
units.literal: When Erzhu Rong attacked Ge Rong, he had Shenwu persuade seven bandit chiefs styling themselves kings to submit.

units.zh: 累遷第三鎮人酋長，常在榮帳內。
units.en: He rose to become chief of the third garrison peoples and remained constantly at Erzhu Rong's side.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to chief of the third garrison populations and was constantly within Rong's tent.

units.zh: 於是大聚斂，因劉貴貨榮下要人，盡得其意。
units.en: Gao Huan amassed wealth on a grand scale and, through Liu Gui, bought off Erzhu Rong's inner circle until he knew their minds completely.
units.literal: Thereupon he greatly gathered riches; through Liu Gui he bribed Rong's key men and came fully to know their intentions.

units.zh: 時州庫角無故自鳴，神武異之，無幾而孝莊誅榮。
units.en: About then a horn in the provincial storehouse sounded of its own accord; Gao Huan took it for an omen—and soon Emperor Xiaozhuang killed Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: At the time the horn of the provincial storehouse spontaneously sounded without cause; Shenwu took it as strange; before long Xiaozhuang executed Rong.

units.zh: 因隨榮之廄。
units.en: He then followed Rong into the stables.
units.literal: Thereupon he followed Rong to the stables.

units.zh: 廄有惡馬，榮命翦之。
units.en: A vicious stallion was in the stable, and Rong ordered its mane clipped.
units.literal: In the stable there was a vicious horse; Rong ordered its mane clipped.

units.zh: 榮遂坐神武於床下，屏左右而訪時事。
units.en: Rong then seated Gao Huan below his couch, dismissed his attendants, and questioned him on the state of the realm.
units.literal: Rong thereupon seated Shenwu below his couch, dismissed those on either side, and inquired about current affairs.

units.zh: 榮曰：「但言爾意。」
units.en: Rong replied, "Tell me what you have in mind."
units.literal: Rong said: "Just speak your mind."

units.zh: 榮大悅，語自日中至夜半，乃出。
units.en: Rong was delighted; they talked from noon until midnight before Gao Huan left.
units.literal: Rong was greatly pleased; they spoke from midday until midnight before he departed.

units.zh: 後從榮徙據幷州，抵揚州邑人龐蒼鷹，止團焦中。
units.en: Later, when Rong shifted his base to Bing Province, Gao Huan stayed with Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township in a round-walled compound called Tuanjiao.
units.literal: Later following Rong he moved to hold Bing Province, arrived at Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township, and lodged in a round walled compound.

units.zh: 榮以神武為前鋒。
units.en: Rong made Gao Huan his vanguard.
units.literal: Rong made Shenwu vanguard.

units.zh: 及帝暴崩，榮遂入洛，因將篡位。
units.en: When the emperor died suddenly, Rong entered Luoyang and prepared to seize the throne himself.
units.literal: When the emperor suddenly died, Rong then entered Luoyang and intended to usurp the throne.

units.zh: 榮嘗問左右曰：「一日無我，誰可主軍？」
units.en: Rong once asked his companions, "If I were gone, who could lead these armies?"
units.literal: Rong once asked those beside him: "One day without me — who could command the army?"

units.zh: 以明公雄武，乘時奮發，討鄭儼、徐紇而清帝側，霸業可舉鞭而成。
units.en: With your might, my lord, rise now, strike down Zheng Yan and Xu He, cleanse the emperor's side—and dominion over the realm is yours at a flick of the whip.
units.literal: With your heroic martial power, sir, if you seize the moment and strike, punish Zheng Yan and Xu He and cleanse the emperor's side — hegemony can be achieved at a flick of the whip.

units.zh: 皆稱尒朱兆。
units.en: All named Erzhu Zhao.
units.literal: All named Erzhu Zhao.

units.zh: 因誡兆曰：「爾非其匹，終當為其穿鼻。」
units.en: He warned Zhao, "You are no match for him; in the end he will put the ring in your nose."
units.literal: He thereupon warned Zhao: "You are not his match; in the end you will be bridled by him."

units.zh: 至上黨，明帝又私詔停之。
units.en: When the army reached Shangdang, the emperor secretly ordered a halt.
units.literal: Reaching Shangdang, Ming again privately ordered him to halt.

units.zh: 曰：「此正可統三千騎以還，堪代我主衆者，唯賀六渾耳。」
units.en: Rong said, "Zhao can lead three thousand horsemen home, but only Heiliuhun is fit to replace me in command of the host."
units.literal: He said: "This one can just lead three thousand cavalry back; the man fit to replace me in commanding the masses is only Heiliuhun."

units.zh: 神武諫，恐不聽，請鑄像卜之，鑄不成，乃止。
units.en: Gao Huan remonstrated; fearing Rong would not heed him, he had a Buddha image cast for divination—and when the casting failed, Rong abandoned the plan.
units.literal: Shenwu remonstrated; fearing he would not listen, he asked to cast an image and divined by it; the casting did not succeed, and so Rong stopped.

units.zh: 趙郡李渾嘗宴聚名輩，詩酒正驩嘩，㥄後到，一坐無復談話者。
units.en: Li Hun of Zhao commandery once feasted a gathering of eminent men; poetry and wine were in full clamor when Ling arrived late — and the whole table fell silent.
units.literal: Li Hun of Zhao commandery once feasted a gathering of eminent men; poetry and wine were in full clamor when Ling arrived late — the whole company ceased conversation.

units.zh: 罷州，除七兵尚書、清河邑中正。
units.en: When he left the province he was made minister of the seven armories and chief clan elder of Qinghe.
units.literal: When he left the province he was made minister of the seven armories and chief clan elder of Qinghe.

units.zh: 對捍使者尚得死坐，況遊道吐不臣之言，犯慢上之罪，口稱夷、齊，心懷盜跖，欺公賣法，受納苞苴，產隨官厚，財與位積，雖贓汚未露，而姦詐如是。
units.en: Resisting an envoy earns death; how much more unministered words, slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harbors robbers, deceiving the public, taking bribes—wealth piled with rank though bribery was not yet exposed.
units.literal: Resisting an envoy still earns death; how much more Youdao's unministered words, the crime of slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harboring robbers, deceiving the public and selling the law, receiving wrapped bribes—property following office thick, wealth with rank piled; though bribery was not yet exposed, treachery was such.

units.zh: 己卯，分遣大使宣勞四方，下璽書敕州郡曰：「夫四王革代，商、周所以應天，五勝相推，軒、羲所以當運。
units.en: On jimao day he sent great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters, issuing sealed letters of instruction to the provinces and commanderies: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thus answered Heaven; the Five Agents succeeded one another—Xuanyuan and Fuxi thus met their destined turn.
units.literal: On jimao day he dispatched great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters and sent down imperial-seal letters instructing the provinces and commanderies, saying: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thereby answered Heaven; the Five Victories succeeded one another—Xuan and Xi thereby met their fortune.

units.zh: 文襄乃奏吏部郎崔暹為御史中尉，糾劾權豪，無所縱捨，於是風俗更始，私枉路絕。
units.en: Gao Cheng then had Cui Xian of the Ministry of Personnel appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful without sparing any, custom was renewed, and private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.
units.literal: Wenxiang then memorialized to make Cui Xuan of the Ministry of Personnel Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful and wealthy without sparing any, and custom was renewed — private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.

units.zh: 世宗文襄皇帝，諱澄，字子惠，神武長子也，母曰婁太后。
units.en: Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong of Northern Qi, bore the personal name Cheng and the style Zihui. He was the eldest son of Gao Huan; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong Wenxiang, taboo name Cheng, style Zihui, was the eldest son of Shenwu; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.

units.zh: 王嘗侍飲，舉大觴曰：「臣澄勸陛下酒。」
units.en: Once, while attending him at drink, Gao Cheng raised a great goblet and said, "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."
units.literal: Once, while attending him at drink, the Prince raised a great goblet and said: "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."

units.zh: 齊受禪，追諡為文襄皇帝，廟號世宗。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, with the temple name Shizong.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong.

units.zh: 七月戊戌，魏帝詔以文襄為使持節、大丞相、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事、大行臺、渤海王。
units.en: In the seventh month, on wuxu day, the Eastern Wei emperor issued an edict that Gao Cheng be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on wuxu, the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Wenxiang be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 魏中興元年，立為渤海王世子。
units.en: In Zhongxing 1 (531) he was made heir to the Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing of Wei he was established as heir of the Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 三年，入輔朝政，加領左右、京畿大都督。
units.en: In the third year he entered the capital to assist in governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and made Grand Commander of the Capital Region.
units.literal: In the third year he entered to assist court governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and Grand Commander of the Capital Region.

units.zh: 興和二年，加大將軍，領中書監，仍攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Xinghe 2 (540) he was made Grand General and Director of the Secretariat Supervisor while still serving as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the second year of Xinghe he was given Grand General, Director of the Secretariat Supervisor, and still acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 魏帝詔曰：「旣朝野攸憑，安危所系，不得令遂本懷，須有權奪，可復前大將軍，餘如故。」
units.en: The emperor issued an edict, "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your wish; authority must be taken by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."
units.literal: The Wei Emperor issued an edict: "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your original wish; there must be a taking of authority by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."

units.zh: 元象元年，攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Yuanxiang 1 (538) he served as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 選人常以年勞為制，文襄乃釐改前式，銓擢唯在得人。
units.en: appointments had been governed by seniority; Gao Cheng reformed the old practice so that selection rested only on finding the right men.
units.literal: appointments had been governed by years of service; Wenxiang then reformed the former practice, and selection and promotion rested only on getting the right men.

units.zh: 二年，加侍中、開府儀同三司，尚孝靜帝妹馮翊長公主，時年十二，神情儁爽，便若成人。
units.en: In the second year he was made Palace Attendant and Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator and married Princess Chang of Fengyi, Emperor Xiaojing's sister. He was twelve, handsome and spirited, already bearing himself like a man.
units.literal: In the second year he was given Palace Attendant, Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator, and married the Princess Chang of Fengyi, sister of Emperor Xiaojing; he was then twelve, with a handsome and spirited bearing, already like a grown man.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時王居北城東柏堂蒞政，以寵琅邪公主，欲其來往無所避忌，所有侍衛，皆出於外。
units.en: At the time Gao Cheng held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.
units.literal: At the time the Prince held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.

units.zh: 就杜詢講學，敏悟過人，詢甚嘆服。
units.en: He studied under Du Xun; his quickness of mind surpassed all others, and Du Xun came to admire him deeply.
units.literal: He went to Du Xun to study; his quick comprehension surpassed others, and Xun greatly admired him.

units.zh: 天平元年，加使持節、尚書令、大行臺、幷州刺史。
units.en: In Tianping 1 (534) he received Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and the inspectorship of Bing Province.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianping he was given Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Inspector of Bing Province.

units.zh: 辛卯，王遇盜而殂，時年二十九。
units.en: On xinmao Gao Cheng fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.
units.literal: On xinmao the Prince fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.

units.zh: 賊黨去床，因而見殺。
units.en: The assassins dragged him from the bed and killed him.
units.literal: The assassins dragged him from the bed and so he was killed.

units.zh: 葬于峻成陵。
units.en: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.
units.literal: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.

units.zh: 王以為信然，謂可誘而致，乃遺景書曰：
units.en: Gao Cheng believed it and thought he could be lured back; he sent Hou Jing a letter saying,
units.literal: The Prince believed it true and thought he could be lured back; he sent Jing a letter saying:

units.zh: 先王與司徒契闊夷險，孤子相依，偏所眷屬，義貫終始，情存歲寒。
units.en: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you—you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.
units.literal: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you — you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.

units.zh: 待為國士者乃立漆身之節，饋以一餐者便致扶輪之效，況其重於此乎？
units.en: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel—how much more when the bond was weightier than this?
units.literal: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel — how much more when the bond was weightier than this?

units.zh: 常以故舊之義，欲將子孫相托，方為秦晉之匹，共成劉、范之親。
units.en: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.
units.literal: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.

units.zh: 況聞負杖行歌，便以狼顧反噬，不蹈忠臣之路，便陷叛人之地。
units.en: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.
units.literal: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.

units.zh: 力不足以自強，勢不足以自保，率烏合之衆，為累卵之危。
units.en: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.
units.literal: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.

units.zh: 西取救於宇文，南請援於蕭氏，以狐疑之心，為首鼠之事。
units.en: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house—with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.
units.literal: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house — with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.

units.zh: 入秦則秦人不容，歸吳則吳人不信。
units.en: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.
units.literal: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.

units.zh: 當是不逞之人，曲為無端之說，遂懷市虎之疑，乃致投杼之惑。
units.en: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.
units.literal: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.

units.zh: 比來舉止，事已可見，人相疑誤，想自覺知。
units.en: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.
units.literal: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.

units.zh: 闔門大小，悉在司寇，意謂李氏未滅，猶言少卿可反。
units.en: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.
units.literal: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.

units.zh: 孤子無狀招禍，丁天酷罰，但禮由權奪，志在忘私，聊遣偏裨，前驅致討，南兗、揚州，應時剋復。
units.en: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment—yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.
units.literal: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment — yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.

units.zh: 即欲乘機，席捲縣瓠，屬以炎暑，欲為後圖，且令還師，待時更舉。
units.en: I meant to seize the moment and sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.
units.literal: I meant to seize the moment, sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.

units.zh: 今寒膠向折，白露將團，方憑國靈，龔行天罰。
units.en: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.
units.literal: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 器械精新，士馬強盛，內外感恩，上下戮力，三令五申，可赴湯火。
units.en: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.
units.literal: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.

units.zh: 使旗鼓相望，埃塵相接，勢如沃雪，事等注熒。
units.en: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.
units.literal: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.

units.zh: 夫明者去危就安，智者轉禍為福，甯人負我，不我負人，當開從善之途，使有改迷之路。
units.en: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others—open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.
units.literal: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others — open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.

units.zh: 若能卷甲來朝，垂橐還闕者，即當授豫州，必使終君身世。
units.en: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.
units.literal: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.

units.zh: 所部文武更不追攝，進得保其祿位，退則不喪功名。
units.en: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.
units.literal: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.

units.zh: 今王思政等皆孤軍偏將，遠來深入，然其性命在君掌握，脫能刺之，想有餘力。
units.en: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand—if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.
units.literal: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand — if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.

units.zh: 節相加授，永保疆埸。
units.en: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.
units.literal: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.

units.zh: 君門眷屬，可以無患，寵妻愛子，亦送相還，仍為通家，共成親好。
units.en: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back—we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.
units.literal: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back — we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.

units.zh: 君今不能東封函谷，南面稱孤，受制於人，威名頓盡。
units.en: If you cannot now seal Hangu Pass in the east and call yourself king facing south, but must be controlled by others, your renown will at once be spent.
